name: CHMS - RAF Project Demo
author: schearerGroup
description:
This demo should be played in full-screen for everything to work correctly. If you are having issues controlling, ensure to click on the application window to let it access which keys you are pressing.
Important Controls:
- Open the settings menu using the 'P' or 'Start Button' keys.
- Change the current controller type using the 'O' or 'Right Stick' keys.
- All other controls can be seen in the settings menu.

-----------------
This is a demo of the Robotic Assisted Feeding project at Cleveland State University.

This work is supported by NSF grant 1950558.
